caption:
Manifestation is not about hoping harder. It is about moving through 3 clear phases…
ㅤ
📍 First, get specific. Not “more money” or “a good relationship.” Define exactly what you want so your mind and energy have something real to lock onto.
ㅤ
📍 Second, become the version of you who can receive it. This is where most people stop. They want the result but stay in the same identity. Your standards, thoughts, and actions have to match what you are calling in.
ㅤ
📍 Third, release control. Stop checking and chasing. Move like it is already on its way and stay open to receiving.
ㅤ
Try this for 72 hours and watch what shifts ✨

author: Paget Kagy | Quantum Queen
transcript: If you want to manifest something very specific in the next 72 hours, you're going to want to save this video because these are the hacks nobody's putting together. This is called the 72 hour collapse method. And it works because your brain does not know the difference between a memory and a vivid instruction. So only try this if you want it fast because once you start, it really starts to move. So hack one, I don't want you to visualize having the thing, okay? No, we're not visualizing having the thing. We are visualizing the moment right after it happens. The phone call, the text message, that feeling in your chest, that is the frequency that is gonna pull it in. Hack number two, say this out loud with me. I am simply deciding that it is mine. I'm not wishing, I am not hoping, I am deciding and fuck the how. Hack three, for 72 hours, whenever doubt comes in, don't fight it, just say noted, still happening because your brain files certainty differently than it does hope. Hack four, before you go to sleep at night, I want you to give your brain an order. I want you to say, show me the next steps in my dreams because your brain is in theta mode right before you sleep, which is the most programmable. And hack five, I want you to tell one person. And this is not for accountability. This is because once you tell one person, you are moving yourself from hoping and kind of wishing it happens to someone who actually has a plan. And here's why it works in 72 hours specifically. Because at this point, you are not waiting for the universe to respond. You are now collapsing the time between the feeling and the reality. And when you move like it is already done within 72 hours, your decisions, your energy, your attention, everything starts reorganizing around that frequency.
title: The 72-Hour Manifestation Collapse Method
one_liner: A 5-step mental framework to accelerate manifestation by shifting identity, certainty, and subconscious programming.
key_points: Visualize the moment *after* the outcome (the text, the call) — not the outcome itself — to lock in the right emotional frequency
Replace hoping with deciding: say 'I am deciding it is mine' and stop negotiating with doubt — just respond 'noted, still happening'
Before sleep, give your brain a directive to show next steps, exploiting theta-wave programmability
Tell one person your intention — it shifts you from wisher to someone with a plan, accelerating belief and action
